question: Related Questions Q. Born to parents who are not married. 2371 views Q. I miss my Fajr prayer 4723 views Q. Till then we sit down and wait for the Hadith to be completed and then we stand up and Iqama is given. I fear if this is an innovation (biddah) and if other masjids too starts following this way of reciting Hadith when Imam comes to lead for prayer then it may create confusion among people. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 10574 Country: India Title: Dear Mufti Saheb! What is the cmmandment of Shariya if any person performs Witr salah before Isha whether it is valid or not? If not give the resason why. Wassalam Yours Sincerely! Question: Dear Mufti Saheb! What is the cmmandment of Shariya if any person performs Witr salah before Isha whether it is valid or not? If not give the resason why. Wassalam Yours Sincerely! Answer ID: 10574 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 204/149=H/1429) It is not valid, the salah will not be acceptable; since it is wajib to maintain the order i.e. first the fardh of isha then witr . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
